# p5.js (vendored)

`p5.min.js` is p5.js **v1.11.1**, unmodified, from the npm tarball
`https://registry.npmjs.org/p5/-/p5-1.11.1.tgz`
(sha1 `4493f6255574a743a8f1d3949ea5554613e4b6d4`, verified on download).

It's vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so every built page stays a
single self-contained file that works offline. `scripts/build.mjs` inlines it
into the lesson page only.

p5.js is licensed under the GNU LGPL v2.1 — see `LICENSE.txt`. It is included
as a separate, unmodified library; you can swap in any other build of p5.js.
